name: mcal_create_event
description: Create an event in a calendar (`calendar` slug). Times are UTC ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-07-28T07:00:00Z) — convert the user's local time to UTC first. `all_day` defaults to false. Requires the calendar:write scope (403 otherwise). If the calendar has a linked Google calendar, the event is also pushed there. Returns the created event including its new `id`.

calendar.description: Calendar slug to create the event in.
